name: SegFormer-B0 local navigation (v24, source-reviewed demo refinement)
task: Hazcam local obstacles: ground/small stone, substantial obstacle, rover hardware, sky/distant unknown

training.init: Original v11 navigation checkpoint; separate navigation encoder and head only
training.labels: Reviewed partial interiors plus weighted stereo weak supervision; mean per-frame coverage19.70%; unknown255 ignored; source-reviewed class-exclusion labels also suppress false hardware without labelling unknown terrain free
training.population: Every demo frame used for fitting and selection; no held-out test

demo_conformance.population: demo fit/conformance, partial reviewed/weak labels, not an independent test

generalization: Not measured for this new candidate; demo fitting scores are not independent accuracy
how_used: Appearance proposes candidates only. A local route treats a candidate as occupied only when measured stereo supports its size/relief against nearby measured ground; hardware and sky become unknown, never free ground.
limitations: Partial project-reviewed labels and weak geometric supervision. Remaining reviewed false alarms are reported. No zero full-image error, exhaustive rock detection, certified traversability or flight qualification claim. No frame-ID or annotation lookup at inference.

class_exclusion_conformance.label_type: Manually reviewed class exclusion, not ground/safety truth
